mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM report_template_schedules s JOIN report_templates t ON t.id = s.template_id WHERE s.enabled = 1 AND t.status = 'published'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_template_schedules (template_id, enabled, issue_month, issue_day, deadline_offset_days, target_company_ids) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{enabled}, #{issueMonth}, #{issueDay}, #{deadlineOffsetDays}, #{targetCompanyIds}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled), issue_month = VALUES(issue_month), issue_day = VALUES(issue_day), deadline_offset_days = VALUES(deadline_offset_days), target_company_ids = VALUES(target_company_ids)
